row.footnote: Computers includes desktops, laptops, netbooks, tablets, tablet computers, portable or handheld computers (e.g., a personal digital assistant), minicomputers, mainframes and workstations.  Computers does not include equipment with some embedded computing abilities such as game consoles or TV sets, nor does it include computer-controlled machinery or electronic tills. The computers do not have to be owned by the enterprise; it may be a personal computer that is used by the enterprise for its work.
The Internet service does not have to be a corporate account, as long as it is used by the enterprise for its work.

row.rowText: Business Usage Of Cloud Computing Services
row.footnote: IMDA included usage of cloud computing services as topline indicator from year 2018. For year prior to 2018, adoption of Software-as-a-Service was used as proxy for cloud computing services adoption. Cloud computing service models are Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS).
Data Analytics is the use of a set of techniques and tools to extract and analyse information from data, to obtain key insights for the business.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a set of tools that enable simulation of intelligent, human-like behaviour, in computers (e.g., natural language processing, computer vision, logical reasoning). AI-enabled solutions can include software or system that are enhanced by AI components. Some common examples include virtual chatbots, mobile robots, recommendation systems, manufacturing robots, spam filters, facial recognition, smart assistants, robo advisors, and smart building management systems.
